description: COFACTOR-Residential Dataset 1 is the SINTEF project’s Oslo-area hourly electricity, delivered-heat and weather collection. The named release covers eight housing associations, 43 apartment blocks and 2,330 apartments in Oslo and Bærum. Its DataCite description lists 29 CSV files grouped by heating central in a ZIP archive, with building metadata and hourly series largely from 2019 to 2022 or 2023. It states Creative Commons BY 4.0. Individual apartment electricity was aggregated for privacy, while common electricity, district-heating and some sub-meter data remain by building or heating central. This is measured residential operation for demand and retrofit simulations, not a national load census. Different meter availability by file, local-time stamps and aggregation are limitations for apartment-level behaviour. A reviewer-assessed use is checking simulated district-heat and power demand in multi-building housing scenarios. data-cofactor-residential-dataset-2-risvollan-trondheim is the distinct Trondheim deposit already catalogued; neither site should be merged with this one. No ZIP or CSV was downloaded. The release page is freely accessible. The CC BY 4.0 licence permits free reuse with attribution.
